description: Update bomStore to use full pipeline, add GenerateActualBom button/panel components, and add SKU deactivation warning badge to template list
steps: Update src/stores/bomStore.ts: Replace the existing synchronous generateActualBom method with a new async runPipeline method that calls runBomPipeline from src/engines/bomPipeline.ts. Add new state fields: pipelineStatus ('idle'|'running'|'success'|'blocked'), pipelineErrors (PipelineError[]), pipelineWarnings (PipelineError[]), pipelineProgress (current step name). The new runPipeline action accepts { projectId, snapshotId } and fetches needed data (snapshot, measurements, configuration, permissions, compatibility rules) from Supabase, then calls runBomPipeline. On success, persist actual_bom and actual_bom_line rows to Supabase. Keep the existing generateActualBom for backward compatibility but mark as deprecated. Add resetPipeline action to clear pipeline state.

Create src/components/GenerateActualBom/GenerateActualBomButton.tsx - A button component visible only in CONSULTANT mode (following the FinalizeButton pattern from src/components/Finalization/FinalizeButton.tsx). When clicked, calls bomStore.runPipeline(). Shows spinner/disabled state while pipeline runs. Uses data-testid='generate-actual-bom-btn'.

Create src/components/GenerateActualBom/ValidationResultsPanel.tsx - Displays pipeline results: a list of blocking errors (red, with error code and message) and warnings (yellow). Shows pipeline status badge (SUCCESS/BLOCKED). Each error shows its code and human-readable message from errorCatalogue. Uses data-testid='validation-results-panel'.
Create src/components/GenerateActualBom/index.ts - barrel export for GenerateActualBomButton and ValidationResultsPanel.
Update src/components/Toolbar.tsx - Add GenerateActualBomButton to the consultant section of the toolbar, similar to how FinalizeButton is included.

Update src/components/TemplateManagement/TemplateListItem.tsx - Add a BLOCKED warning badge (orange/red, data-testid='sku-inactive-badge') that appears when template has any assigned SKU with status INACTIVE. This requires checking sku status - add a prop 'hasInactiveSkus?: boolean' to the component and display badge conditionally.

Create src/components/GenerateActualBom/__tests__/GenerateActualBomButton.test.tsx - Test that button renders only in CONSULTANT mode, triggers runPipeline on click, shows disabled state while running.

Create src/components/GenerateActualBom/__tests__/ValidationResultsPanel.test.tsx - Test that blocking errors render with correct error codes, warnings render separately, SUCCESS/BLOCKED status displays correctly.
Create src/components/TemplateManagement/__tests__/TemplateListItemInactiveSku.test.tsx - Test that BLOCKED badge appears when hasInactiveSkus=true, is absent when false.
Update src/stores/__tests__/bomStore.test.ts - Add test cases for the new runPipeline method (mock the pipeline and supabase calls) and resetPipeline action.
acceptance_criteria: bomStore has runPipeline async action that calls runBomPipeline and stores results in pipelineStatus/pipelineErrors/pipelineWarnings
GenerateActualBomButton renders only for CONSULTANT mode and triggers pipeline
ValidationResultsPanel displays errors and warnings from pipeline output
TemplateListItem shows BLOCKED badge when hasInactiveSkus is true
All new component and store tests pass
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
findings: All 615 tests pass (517 original + 72 from FEAT-001 + 26 new). TypeScript strict mode passes. Template type requires description, adaptation_strategy, version fields. Project requires version: number (not optional). WallGeometry is a type alias 'STRAIGHT' | 'L_CORNER' (not 'FLAT'). The bomPipeline module must be mocked in store tests via vi.mock. The fromTable mock pattern with chained methods (.select.eq.neq.single) is consistent across all test files.
